spec.name: Halloween Pumpkin Pufferfish
spec.description: A cute, inflated pumpkin pufferfish with a stepped round silhouette, leafy green fins, a tiny stem and painted charcoal jack-o’-lantern features. Static, axis-aligned resource-pack item with transparent negative space.

prompt: Cute round pumpkin orange pufferfish with small green fins and charcoal face marks, static blocky fish. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
